name: 67060 · Haysville, KS
findings: ZIP 67060 (Haysville) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67060 (Haysville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 67060 (Haysville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
